reproduction.rationale: Matched assistance is declared in access-conditions.v1.json, but authentic common/code manifests, evaluation identity, runtime/exposure and finite budgets are not yet frozen. Authenticate the complete Figure 2d neuron/animal/session/face roster, source archive members, feature coordinate order and repetition joins; do not reuse geometry counts as decoder identity. Recover source feature standard-deviation normalization population, 50-ms/10-ms window boundary/grid, native linear decoder and all ten stimulus-identity-shuffle mappings. Recover complete original published/reference curves and panel aggregation, including familiar-query dependence; establish calibrated author replay and a justified numerical reproduction criterion. Predeclare complete-curve improvement, companion-control requirements, meaningful effect and dependence-aware paired inference; no selected region, latency or new aggregate is admissible. Freeze common source representations, exact author-code package, exposure and cumulative resource/search budgets before activating either assistance condition. The selected source endpoint retains a complete metric array without an authenticated original scalar reduction. Existing improvement/v1 scalar admission cannot qualify this full-panel comparison; an additive full-panel comparator/admission engine and reviewed complete-support criterion remain required. No new mean, win count or convenient scalar is substituted.
